title: How Majestic Is Your Name
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: God gets glory from galaxies and from single cells. But he has chosen to show his glory first in mercy and love, even toward enemies like us.
exhortation: What an amazing God we serve. He is so powerful that he can measure the universe with his hand and hold the oceans in his palm. Yet he gets as much glory from the small things as from the big things. The complexity of a single cell brings him glory. Newborn babies bring him glory. Everywhere we look, we see the glory of God. There's no getting away from it.

And yet the most amazing thing of all is that God has chosen to show his glory first and foremost in his mercy and love. Even more astounding, it is mercy and love shown to enemies and sinners like us. What a God we serve. There truly is no one like our God.
prayer: God, we praise you and honor you and give you the glory due your name. Jesus, to see even a glimpse of your glory would utterly transform us.
May we see you this morning, and may our lips declare your praise.
